owner.rule: Canonical academic identity is defined here and projected later; the existing Programming runtime is not mutated by PYTHON02.

topology.legacyStageMeaning: compatibility/delivery projection, not canonical competency identity

evidenceSemantics.progress: A workflow step or practice interaction was completed.
evidenceSemantics.performance: Validated task/code/reasoning evidence was produced under an assessment contract.
evidenceSemantics.mastery: Policy projection over accepted performance evidence; never inferred from route completion or quiz score alone.

versionPolicy.bindingRule: Do not bind a Python minor version until PYTHON04 runtime contract or authoritative target requirements prove it.
versionPolicy.thirdPartyRule: Package semantics require package name plus version context and official package documentation.

downstreamContracts.PYTHON03: May define code-reasoning/debugging/assessment semantics against py.comp and canonical entity IDs; it may not invent runtime authority.
downstreamContracts.PYTHON04: May bind runtime/toolchain/package versions and providers; it must consume PYTHON02 semantics and PYTHON03 evidence contracts.
downstreamContracts.PYTHON05: May author/render projections but cannot become a second curriculum truth owner.
